description: The room window shows only the interface bundled in the app (local pages). It may report call state (and the microphone and playback levels) to the tray and the call controls card, use the native model engine (docs/ENGINES.md) and run the voice call the app runs itself (host.voice), both through the shared plugin sidevoice-app-tauri (its ACL.md) and read and request the app's microphone access or open its pane in System Settings (host.microphone; docs/BRIDGE.md), reach this computer's own core through the app (the local host: its state, its pairing, the service's actions, and installing Sidevoice on this computer from the npm registry, docs/LOCAL_HOST.md), write its console warnings and errors, uncaught errors and unhandled rejections to the app log (log:allow-log; bridge/webview-log.js), and (CI and diagnostics only, printed with SIDEVOICE_DEBUG=1) print a debug line. It may read and set the global mute shortcut and whether the call controls card always shows during a call (host.muteShortcut, host.callControls; docs/BRIDGE.md). In a release, it may read and set how the app's updates arrive, read their status, check, download, cancel a download and restart into a downloaded update (host.updater; docs/BRIDGE.md). In a nightly or a dev build, it may turn the developer options (the Web Inspector, WebKit compositing borders and repaint counters) on the room and the call controls card on or off (host.debug; docs/BRIDGE.md). Nothing else.
